notes.title: Quick Fix Update – Menu Issue Resolved!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much to everyone who checked out [b]Wake Explorer[/b] at launch! We really appreciate your support and feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]We wanted to let you know we’ve just pushed a small update to fix an issue with the in-game menu that some players encountered. Everything should now be working as intended — smoother and more responsive.[/p][p][/p][p]If you experienced any problems navigating the menu before, this update should take care of it. Please restart the game or verify your files if the issue persists.[/p][p][/p][p]If you run into anything else, feel free to reach out.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing![/p][p]– The Wake Explorer Team[/p]
